title: Maamoul Cookie Moulding
tagline: Fill, seal and knock out carved cookies, then catch the oven at pale gold.
description: Work a bakery bench in the Levant: choose a carved mould, drop the date, walnut or pistachio filling at the marked amount, pinch the dough shut, knock it out in three beats and set it on the tray. Bake it at the pale-gold moment. Eighteen shifts, Rush Hour, a Daily Shift, a Pattern Book and Watch and Learn.
howToPlay: Tap a mould on the rack to start a cookie.
Tap the bench when the filling reaches the dashed ring.
Drag a finger once round the rim to seal the dough.
Tap three knock beats as each ring closes on the mould.
Set the cookie on its slot, then pull the tray at pale gold.
